preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: All elements in arr are strings.
The length of arr is between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 30 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in arr has length between 1 and 30 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (all(any(s == candidate[:i] for s in arr) for i in range(1, len(return_value) + 1)) and all(len(s) <= len(return_value) for s in arr if all(any(s == candidate[:j] for j in range(1, len(s) + 1)) for s in arr)) and (len(return_value) > len(s) for s in arr if all(any(s == candidate[:j] for j in range(1, len(s) + 1)) for s in arr)) or (len(return_value) == len(s) and return_value < s for s in arr if all(any(s == candidate[:j] for j in range(1, len(s) + 1)) for s in arr)))
postconditions.description: If return_value is non-empty, it is the lexicographically smallest string in arr such that all its prefixes are present in arr, and it is the longest such string. If no such string exists, return_value is an empty string.
